attacks.name: Spider Staff
attacks.effect: Add 1d6 poison to the same hit. Weapon attack, not a spell.
attacks.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 59

attacks.name: Ray of Frost
attacks.effect: On a hit, target speed reduced by 10 ft. until start of Nezznar’s next turn. Level-4 caster: one damage die. PHB 2014 p. 271.
attacks.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 59

attacks.name: Shocking Grasp
attacks.effect: Advantage against metal armor; on hit target cannot take reactions until start of its next turn. PHB 2014 p. 275.
attacks.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 59

actions.name: Staff · extra poison
actions.effect: No saving throw is specified for this staff’s extra weapon damage.
actions.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 59

actions.name: Magic Missile · one dart
actions.effect: Three darts using a 1st-level slot; four at 2nd level. Assign each dart before damage. Shield blocks them. PHB 2014 p. 257.
actions.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 59

actions.name: Potion of Healing
actions.effect: One potion; use the campaign’s 2014 action cost unless a table ruling overrides it. LMoP p. 53.
actions.source: Lost Mine of Phandelver (2014), appendix B, printed p. 59
